integrity: All claims are supported by a self-contained induction and a reproducible direct finite checker; no independent audit or publication is claimed. Literature comparisons carry residual equivalence risk.
scientific_limitations: Finite rooted b-ary trees; root-fixed and parent-preserving endomorphisms only, not arbitrary graph maps; explicit recursion rather than one-formula all-height solution. Unweighted totals follow from prior general wreath-product theorem.
title: Image-fibre recursions and gap-free rank spectra for rooted-tree retractions
